verdict.rationale: Reflect has built-in AI features: an AI palette, chat with filtered notes, and a choice of GPT-4o or Claude. An AI-enabled notes app could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows Reflect can connect to or plug in MCP servers. Its REST API, deep links and Zapier integrations are a different, inbound capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
